### Quarto document containing my analysis:
Load in the libraries and data:

```{r}
# Read in libraries
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(readxl)


# Read in data and do basic cleaning
avalanche_data <- read_excel(here("eds-222-finalproj", "data", "CAIC_Accident_Data_Oct_2025.xlsx"))

nino_data <- read_csv(here("eds-222-finalproj", "data", "nino34.long.anom.csv"))
colnames(nino_data) <- c("date", "sst_anomaly")
```

states <- unique(avalanche_data$State)

Brainstorm:
I want to look at how el nino phase affects avalanche incidents. For the el nino phase I am going to look sea surface temperature anomaly because it is continuous. For snowfall I am going to look at snowfal total per year in inches.

| Variable                  	| Predictor or Response 	| Data Type   	| Discrete or Continuous 	| Values/Units      	|
|---------------------------	|-----------------------	|-------------	|------------------------	|-------------------	|
| Fatal Avalanche Incidents 	| Response              	| integer     	| discrete               	| [0, 1, 2, ...]    	|
| EL Nino Phase             	| Predictor             	| double      	| continuous             	| xx.xx sst anomaly 	|
| Year                      	| Predictor             	| categorical 	| discrete               	| [19XX, ..., 2026] 	|
| Average Snowfall          	| Predictor             	| double      	| continuous             	| xx.xx inches      	|
| State                     	| Predictor             	| categorical 	| discrete               	| ["CA","CO","NM"]  	|
| Skiers                    	| Predictor             	| categorical 	| discrete               	| ["High", "Low"]   	|
